articles.title: Kings Group CEO Donates Furniture to Moree Schools
articles.author: Kings Group
articles.excerpt: Kings Group CEO Ekow Nkrumah Bentum has donated about 330 pieces of school furniture to selected schools in Moree to improve learning conditions in the community.

body.text: The Chief Executive Officer of Kings Group (including Kings Furniture), Ekow Nkrumah Bentum, has donated about 330 pieces of school furniture to selected schools in Moree.
The gesture, according to Mr Bentum, a native of Moree, was to improve the dire furniture situation in schools in the community.
Faustina Ansah Kow-Dadzie, a pupil of Moree DA Basic and a beneficiary, could not hide her joy.
Community Impact

The donation of 330 pieces of school furniture represents a significant investment in the educational infrastructure of Moree. This initiative directly addresses the overcrowding issues that have been affecting students' learning experiences in the community schools.
Mr. Bentum's connection to Moree as a native of the area demonstrates Kings Group's commitment to giving back to the communities that have supported the company's growth and success.
Educational Support Initiative

This furniture donation is part of Kings Group's broader educational support initiative, aimed at improving learning conditions in schools across Ghana. The company recognizes that proper furniture is essential for creating conducive learning environments.
The donated furniture includes desks and chairs specifically designed for school use, ensuring that students have appropriate seating and workspace for their studies.

articles.title: Kings Group Empowers Staff to Be More Effective
articles.author: Kings Group
articles.excerpt: Kings Group Ghana presented four motorbikes to deserving employees across its Takoradi and Accra branches, reinforcing its commitment to staff welfare and empowerment.

body.text: Takoradi-based Kings Group Ghana Limited has reaffirmed its commitment to staff welfare and empowerment by presenting four motorbikes to deserving employees across its Takoradi and Accra branches.

The presentation, which took place during a staff morning gathering, was aimed at encouraging hard work and dedication among team members — a clear signal of the company's appreciation for the people behind its success.
According to General Manager Mr. Sylvester Annan-Mensah, the motorbikes were intended to empower staff logistically and motivate them to keep delivering exceptional results.
The beneficiaries were drawn from across the company, including the Stores Department, two staff members from the Sales and Marketing Department, and one from the Production Department.
Mr. Annan-Mensah emphasised that the company deeply values its staff and remains committed to empowering them to excel in their roles.
Corporate Social Responsibility

Kings Group Ghana Limited has built a strong reputation for its corporate social responsibility initiatives, having made donations to several schools and institutions, including a recent contribution to the Sekondi Prisons.

The company, which has grown from a humble furniture manufacturing business into a diversified group comprising Kings Furniture, Kings Deco, and Kings Byte, remains committed to building strong relationships with its customers while empowering its staff to drive growth and success.
Staff Response
The beneficiaries thanked management for the gesture and pledged to take good care of the motorbikes and continue working hard to meet the company's expectations.

articles.title: Kings Group Donates Office and Domestic Furniture to Four Institutions
articles.author: Kings Group
articles.excerpt: Kings Group donated office and domestic furniture to four institutions across the Sekondi-Takoradi Metropolis, supporting their official duties as part of its ongoing CSR efforts.

body.text: The management of Kings Group of Companies, a leading furniture manufacturer in Ghana, has donated a range of office and domestic furniture to four institutions within the Sekondi-Takoradi Metropolis in the Western Region.
The beneficiary institutions were the Ghana National Fire Service, the Ghana Prison Service, the Sekondi-Takoradi Metropolitan Assembly, and the Effia-Kwesimintsim Municipal Assembly.

Presenting the items at a brief ceremony, General Manager Mr. Sylvester Annan-Mensah said the company recognised the efforts of the beneficiary institutions and had decided to assist them with furniture to support their official duties.
He added that this was not the first time the company had taken such an initiative — and it would not be the last.

ACF-1 Frederick Ohemeng, Western Regional Fire Commander, and Madam Yayra A. Ashong-Mettle, Western Regional Assistant Director of the Ghana Prisons Service, received the items on behalf of the beneficiaries and expressed their gratitude to Kings Group. They called on other corporate bodies and benevolent members of society to emulate the gesture.
Company Officials Present

Other company officials present at the ceremony included Mr. John Afful (HR Manager), Mrs. Rachel Koomson (Takoradi Branch Manageress), Mr. Ekow Takyi (Finance Manager), Mr. Augustine Arthur (Deputy Finance Manager), Mr. Seth Fosu (Production Manager), and Mr. Elisha Kwadwo Kwakye (Marketing and Sales Manager).
About Kings Group of Companies

Kings Group of Companies is a leading furniture manufacturer in Ghana, committed to providing high-quality furniture solutions for homes, offices, and institutions. The company has consistently demonstrated its commitment to corporate social responsibility through a range of community initiatives.

articles.title: Kings Group Opens First Ultra-Modern Furniture Shop in Takoradi
articles.author: Kings Group
articles.excerpt: Kings Group officially opened Furniture Mall, its first ultra-modern furniture shop, at the Takoradi Mall — a proud milestone in the company's three-decade journey, marked with over GH¢170,600 in donations.

body.text: Kings Group of Companies has officially opened its first ultra-modern furniture shop, Furniture Mall, at the Takoradi Mall in the Sekondi-Takoradi Metropolis — a proud milestone in the company's three-decade journey through Ghana's furniture manufacturing and retail industry.

The opening ceremony also served as a platform to present furniture and cash to several institutions and individuals who had written to the company for support, as part of its corporate social responsibility initiatives.
CEO's Vision for Furniture Mall

Speaking at the grand opening, Mr. Ekow Nkrumah-Bentum, Chief Executive Officer of Kings Group, said Furniture Mall was positioned to offer high-quality and affordable furniture solutions for homes, offices, and hotels.

He announced that the collections ranged from contemporary designs to timeless classics — reflecting sophistication, comfort, and artistic flair — and invited the public to visit for a shopping experience that combines luxury and value.
Quality Materials, Lasting Comfort

Mr. Nkrumah-Bentum reflected on the company's humble beginnings in 1992 as Kings Furniture Works, formally registered in 1996, and noted that the company would celebrate its 30th anniversary the following year.
He disclosed that the company, with branches in Accra and Takoradi, employs over 120 staff members who have helped build its solid reputation for innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction.
Corporate Social Responsibility

In his welcome address, General Manager Mr. Sylvester Annan-Mensah stated that the company had donated cash, furniture, and educational support to numerous institutions and individuals, totalling One Hundred and Seventy Thousand, Six Hundred Ghana Cedis (GH¢170,600.00). Twelve institutions from the Western and Central Regions received donations at the event.
Beneficiary Institutions

The institutions that received donations included Holy Child College of Education; the Rapid Deployment Forces of the Ghana Police Service, Takoradi; the Ghana Prisons Service, Sekondi; Good Shepherd Anglican JHS; Takoradi Technical Institute; Opportunities Industrialization Technical Institute (formerly OIC); Catholic Special Vocation School, Sekondi; Moree D/A Basic School; Police Basic School, Cape Coast; Ghana National Fire Service, Asankragua; All Saints Anglican JHS, Takoradi; and Powerful Jesus Prayer Ministry.
Municipal Recognition

The Municipal Chief Executive of the Effia-Kwesimintsim Municipal Assembly, Abdul Majeed Dokurgu, commended Mr. Nkrumah-Bentum, founder of Kings Group, for the humility, innovation, and consistency that have driven the company's success over the years.

He further praised the company for its contributions to job creation, human development, and institutional growth, and urged staff to continue giving their best to propel the company to greater heights.

articles.title: Kings Group Board Chairman Appointed to Tree Crop Development Authority Board
articles.author: Kings Group
articles.excerpt: Mr. Kweku Kum, seasoned accountant and Board Chairman of Kings Group, has been appointed to the Board of the Tree Crop Development Authority, representing the Association of Self-Finance Outgrowers.

body.text: The President Mahama administration has appointed Mr. Kweku Kum, a seasoned accountant and Board Chairman of Kings Group of Companies, as a Board Member of the Tree Crop Development Authority (TCDA), where he represents the Association of Self-Finance Outgrowers (ASFRO).

The appointment is a significant development for the TCDA, which was established by an Act of Parliament in 2019 to regulate and develop the production, processing, and trading of six tree crops in Ghana: cashew, shea, mango, coconut, rubber, and oil palm.

As a Board Member, Mr. Kum will play a crucial role in supporting the Authority's efforts to promote the development of the tree crop sector. His experience as a seasoned accountant and his leadership at Kings Group make him well-suited to help guide the TCDA's work, bringing stability and direction as it establishes itself as a key player in the sector.

The TCDA was set up to address longstanding challenges in the tree crop sector, including low productivity, limited access to finance, and inadequate infrastructure. By supporting farmers, processors, and traders, it aims to improve the sector's competitiveness and increase its contribution to Ghana's economic development.
Mr. Kum prides himself as an ardent farmer with acres of rubber plantation and cassava, and brings vast practical experience in tree crop management to the role.
About the Tree Crop Development Authority

The Tree Crop Development Authority was established by Act 992 of 2019 to regulate and develop the production, processing, and trading of tree crops in Ghana. The Authority focuses on six key crops — cashew, shea, mango, coconut, rubber, and oil palm — which are vital to Ghana's agricultural economy and export potential.

articles.title: Kings Furniture Honoured at 2025 Ghana Impactful Companies Awards
articles.author: Kings Group
articles.excerpt: Kings Furniture was named among 23 distinguished companies at the 2025 Ghana Impactful Companies Awards, recognising its contributions to economic growth through innovation, integrity, and social responsibility.

body.text: Kings Furniture has been honoured at the 2025 Ghana Impactful Companies Awards, an annual ceremony celebrating organisations that demonstrate outstanding contributions to Ghana's economic growth through innovation, integrity, and social responsibility.
The company emerged as one of 23 distinguished honourees selected from a competitive pool of nominees.

Mr. Ekow Nkrumah-Bentum, Chief Executive Officer of Kings Group of Companies, expressed appreciation for the recognition, saying the award reflects the company's unwavering dedication to quality, innovation, and its broader impact on Ghana's corporate ecosystem. "This achievement reaffirms our leadership in the furniture manufacturing industry," he added.

This year's ceremony, themed "Increasing the Social and Economic Benefits of Business Activities in Ghana," brought together top business executives, policymakers, investors, and media personalities to celebrate excellence across various sectors.
The latest accolade further strengthens Kings Furniture's reputation as a frontrunner in Ghana's manufacturing landscape.
